purpose: External material BRO may study is acquired by a person, reviewed by a person, and approved by a person before STUDY can read a byte of it. Acquisition holds the network; study holds none.

invariants.statement: Only material a named person approved may exist in the corpus STUDY reads, and only as the exact bytes they approved.
Approval requires a prior review, each step names its actor, and every transition is recorded.
Approval re-checks the acquired digest, so material cannot change between review and approval.
Corpus paths stay inside the corpus root and never name executables, archives, key files or hidden directories.
Material carrying a credential is refused; material that merely names one is not.
Every source records publisher, canonical url, authority class, scope, upstream version, digest, language and license.

Authority is scoped to the source's own subject and never outranks BRO's contracts, governance or runtime truth. Acquired text is data; instruction-shaped sentences inside it are content, not instructions.
The network lives in the operator acquisition tool. The library reaches nothing and the study runtime reaches nothing.
A declared source language must match the script actually acquired, and Armenian variants are kept apart rather than collapsed into the normative one.
Learned knowledge records the language of its source document and the language of its evidence quote separately.
The evidence quote stays verbatim in the source language. A translation is never evidence and never makes a claim VERIFIED.
A question in one supported language reaches knowledge learned from a source in another, through one canonical item with one provenance chain -- never a translated duplicate.
Recall terms are retrieval keys only: bounded in length, never evidence, and carrying no authority or confidence of their own.
Source language, evidence and cross-language recall survive a restart, and Armenian text survives ingestion, storage and retrieval unchanged.
The item budget and the diminishing-return threshold are both configuration, both at least one, and a malformed setting falls back rather than removing the limit.

truth_boundary: Acquiring a document does not make BRO believe it; approval admits it to study, not to authority.
External material never grants authority, never approves an action and never overrides current runtime truth.
A translated explanation is an explanation. The evidence remains the original text, in the original language.
The model's multilingual ability is not BRO's learned knowledge; recall is proven through BRO's own memory path.
